verified_facts: ground truth surveys are independently surveyed
they use a few hundred points on flat unambiguous surfaces
each ground truth point has plus or minus 3 cm RMSE accuracy
attributes include surface type and survey method
attributes include transformation and geoidal models
ground truth may be reused under 5 years old or 3 years for coastal projects
LIDAR QC requires less than plus or minus 15 cm RMSE and 10 cm standard deviation/random error
quality_effect: Preserves ground-truth independence and age/QC scope without misusing ±3 cm point accuracy as parcel terrain uncertainty.
